title: The Double Standard of My Mental Health Break 😤 #shorts
description:
Speaker laments the public backlash they received for taking time off, expressing profound disappointment with how their mental health break was negatively twisted by the press. They highlight the stark irony that athletes like Simone Biles and Michael Phelps are celebrated for similar decisions, questioning why young professionals face such scrutiny for prioritizing life over work. ⚡
